verdict.rationale: MoonPay documents its own API reference with endpoint pages (quotes, sessions), defines the API in an OpenAPI 3.1 spec, and offers first-party clone-able working example integrations plus a test mode. Nothing shows the reference itself is interactive, such as a try-it console where requests run from the docs page, and probes of common OpenAPI paths returned 404. missing for 10: evidence of an interactive in-browser API explorer, runnable request examples embedded in the reference, a publicly reachable spec file, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples

citations.quote: Builds a quote for a fiat-to-crypto buy. Returns locked rate, fees, and signature for payment execution.
The MoonPay Developer Platform API is defined using an OpenAPI 3.1 specification.
GitHub repository has working, clone-able example integrations ready to use - just add your API keys.
MoonPay provides a test mode for integration development and testing.
